plain_english: By this mere knowing, all powers know; a kinsman of the śākinī clan he may be, even without yoga.
sanskrit_cite: anena jñātamatreṇa jñāyate sarvaśaktibhiḥ śākinīkulasāmānyo bhavedyogaṃ vināpi hi |

plain_english: Ignorant of rite, knowing ordinance, he turns to worship — having made time-fire from the first, ending in māyā, gone to the brahma-body.
sanskrit_cite: avidhijño vidhānajño jāyate yajanaṃ prati kālāgnimāditaḥ kṛtvā māyāntaṃ brahmadehagam |

plain_english: Śiva, whose end is endless all, deemed the supreme power-triad; whatever stands on the pure path abides inside that.
sanskrit_cite: śivo viśvādyanantāntaḥ paraṃ śaktitrayaṃ matam tadantarvarti yatkiñcit śuddhamārge vyavasthitam |

plain_english: The atom soon attains pure lordly knowing; its mover is Śiva to be known, all-knowing highest Lord.
sanskrit_cite: aṇurviśuddhamacirādaiśvaraṃ jñānamaśnute taccodakaḥ śivo jñeyaḥ sarvajñaḥ parameśvaraḥ |

plain_english: All-going, stainless, clear, full, self-aboded, bright — like the great power-formed tree standing in the banyan seed.
sanskrit_cite: sarvago nirmalaḥ svacchastṛptaḥ svāyatanaḥ śuciḥ yathānyagrodhabījasthaḥ śaktirūpo mahādrumaḥ |

plain_english: So stands this moving-still world in the heart-seed; who knows it truly — his is the freedom-going.
sanskrit_cite: tathā hṛdayabījasthaṃ jagadetaccarācaram evaṃ yo vetti tattvena tasya nirvāṇagāminī |

plain_english: Initiation becomes undoubted, free of sesame-ghee offering — on crown, face, and heart, on the hidden, on the form, and so indeed.
sanskrit_cite: dīkṣā bhavatyasaṃdigdhā tilājyāhutivarjitā mūrdhni vaktre ca hṛdaye guhye mūrtau tathaiva ca |

plain_english: Placing done, topknot bound, twenty-seven-muttered; with each one let the ten quarters' binding be yoked.
sanskrit_cite: nyāsaṃ kṛtvā śikhāṃ baddhvā saptaviṃśatimantritām ekaikaṃ tu diśāṃ bandhaṃ daśānāmapi yojayet |

plain_english: Three claps first, sounded, to clear obstacles; with topknot-count thrice-told, then sprinkle water.
sanskrit_cite: tālatrayaṃ purā datvā saśabdaṃ vighnaśāntaye śikhāsaṃkhyātijaptena toyenābhyukṣayettataḥ |
